motivation: Remove the v0.1 S0 scale confound, make the fold-sign result primary rather than rhetorical, and separate alpha calibration from untouched confirmation outcomes.
claim_boundary: This successor can test whether magnitude-matched, identity-selected local projectors exhibit a context-stable and geometry-specific interaction algebra on frozen Qwen-0.8B graph tasks. It cannot authorize signed or disparate weight edits, establish a global high-rank fiber, demonstrate compactification, or provide evidence of recursive self-improvement.

frozen_sources.projectors: Reuse the exact selected and orthogonal matched-random directions from the v0.1 registration; no basis refit is permitted.
frozen_sources.model_and_runtime: Identical model bytes, NF4 runtime, hooks, layers, centering, and final-prompt-token intervention as v0.1.

stage_C0_scale_calibration.prompt_universe: The 72 v0.1 evaluation prompts, geometry_validation rows with within_half_index 0 through 7. These outcomes are already revealed and may never enter confirmation gates.

selected_arm.source: Rerun the complete selected-arm cube using the v0.2 primary answer-margin score. The v0.1 log-probability cube is planning evidence only and cannot enter calibration arithmetic.

stage_C0_scale_calibration.matched_random_measurement: Run the complete 16-mask cube at every registered alpha using the v0.2 primary answer-margin score. No v0.1 outcome is reused in scale matching.
stage_C0_scale_calibration.scale_statistic_formula_ascii: scale(arm, alpha) = sqrt(mean_{prompt, mask != 0}((score(prompt, mask) - score(prompt, 0))^2))
stage_C0_scale_calibration.selection_rule: Choose the random alpha minimizing abs(log(scale_random(alpha) / scale_selected(1.0))). Break exact ties toward the smaller alpha.

calibration_validity.rule: The selected/random scale ratio at the chosen alpha must lie in [0.8, 1.25].

seal_before_confirmation: chosen alpha and deterministic tie-break receipt
exact grouped folds and gate table

stage_C1_untouched_confirmation.prompt_universe: The 72 previously unused graph_reachability geometry_validation prompts with within_half_index 8 through 15, eight prompts in each of nine frozen subconditions.
stage_C1_untouched_confirmation.outcome_separation: No C1 prompt score, logit, generation, or causal delta may be read before the C0 selection receipt is hashed and committed.

arms.matched_random: Complete 16-mask cube at the sealed C0 alpha.

primary_score.name: correct_vs_incorrect_teacher_forced_answer_log_likelihood_margin
primary_score.definition: For expected YES, score = log P(ANSWER=YES | prompt) - log P(ANSWER=NO | prompt); reverse the terms for expected NO. Use identical prefix handling and completion-token aggregation in both terms.
primary_score.reason: A paired answer margin reduces dependence on a single probability-floor scale while remaining behaviorally interpretable.

stage_C1_untouched_confirmation.continuity_score: The v0.1 mean log probability of the correct registered completion is reported secondary and cannot replace the primary margin.

analysis.complete_design: All 16 masks identify the full Boolean multilinear response through order four; no lower-order truncation is used to estimate the exact per-prompt coefficients.
analysis.folds: Nine leave-one-subcondition-out folds, sealed before C1 outcomes.
analysis.degree2_increment: For each fold, fit global degree<=1 and degree<=2 response models on the other eight subconditions and compare prediction SSE on the held-out subcondition.

fold_sign_test.success_rule: At least 8 of 9 folds have strictly positive degree-2 SSE reduction; the exact one-sided sign-test p-value is at most 10/512 = 0.01953125.
fold_sign_test.failure_rule: At least 8 of 9 folds have strictly negative degree-2 SSE reduction.
fold_sign_test.ties: Exactly zero counts as neither sign and cannot help either boundary.

aggregate_increment_gate.role: A success must clear both the fold-sign gate and this minimum practical effect. Bootstrap intervals are descriptive because nine clusters are thin.

absolute_higher_order_energy.specificity_estimand: Within each subcondition, mean E_ge2(selected) minus mean E_ge2(magnitude_matched_random).
absolute_higher_order_energy.success_sign_rule: At least 8 of 9 subcondition differences are strictly positive.
absolute_higher_order_energy.practical_ratio_rule: The geometric-mean selected/random E_ge2 ratio must exceed 1.5625, the square of the maximum permitted 1.25 residual scale mismatch.
absolute_higher_order_energy.zero_handling: Use a preregistered numerical epsilon equal to machine epsilon times the squared median absolute baseline score; report every epsilon-affected cell.

forbidden_primary_statistics: degree>=2 energy fraction as a selected-vs-random specificity gate
prompt-level bootstrap treating 72 prompts as independent clusters

gate_sequence.C0_scale_match: Pass only when the frozen alpha-selection rule produces a ratio inside [0.8, 1.25].
gate_sequence.N0_replay: The no-intervention baseline and duplicate replay must agree within 0.0001 on both registered scores.
gate_sequence.L0_liveness: Both arms must have full-cube scale at least 0.001 on the primary score; otherwise interaction specificity is not evaluated.
gate_sequence.I1_context_stable_nonadditivity: Pass only when the 8-of-9 positive fold-sign rule and the 2% aggregate practical margin both pass.
gate_sequence.S0_geometry_specific_absolute_energy: Pass only when the 8-of-9 paired sign rule and the derived 1.5625 practical ratio both pass.
gate_sequence.full_success: Requires C0, N0, L0, I1, and S0 all to pass in order.
gate_sequence.stop_rule: Any failed, invalid, unavailable, or inconclusive upstream gate stops downstream interpretation; no near-enough override.

test_receipt_requirement.rule: Every release receipt records the literal pytest command, repository commit, test collection count, pass count, fail count, and exit code.
minimum_tests: outcome seal prevents C1 read before C0 commit
